Race: Halfling
Code Name: Bloodrain
Libido and Lewdness Level: 4.0 / 5.0

Vivian’s mother, and a halfling. She is a teacher at the spy academy, and her codename is “Bloodrain.” Despite her small stature, her boobs boast an impressive T-cup size.

A woman dressed in gothic lolita fashion just like her daughter, giving off a lazy and melancholic atmosphere. It is said that no one can rival her when it comes to handling knives, and during her active years she apparently went too far so often that she regularly turned places into seas of blood. Incidentally, the Oscura family is famous as a former lineage of assassins. Victoria’s mother worried about her daughter and granddaughter continuing down the path of assassins, and enrolled them into the spy academy so they could live under the light of day instead.

Her subjects are home economics and assassination techniques, an extreme contrast. In home economics classes, both her cooking and sewing skills are at a professional level, and the sewing club she runs after school is apparently always completely full. During assassination training, she wears a handmade apron so her clothes do not get stained with blood while taking down monsters.

She has a decadent atmosphere and a mysterious personality. She shows absolutely no mercy toward enemies, but toward students she is surprisingly sensible and gives accurate advice. Among the teachers, because of her height difference, she is doted on almost like a younger sister (though she dislikes it).

Her relationship with her daughter is good, and the two often sew together to make new outfits for Vivian. Incidentally, the women of the Oscura family have apparently worn gothic lolita fashion for generations. She secretly supports her daughter’s efforts to improve the social standing of halflings.

Toward the protagonist, she holds a certain kind of interest. The reason it is “a certain kind” is because she has never assassinated a ninja before, so she has a frightening interest in the protagonist’s neck. However, as she spends more time with him, she gradually begins to open up.

Her hobbies are assassination, cooking and sewing, and maintaining her weapons. The things she dislikes are brightly colored clothes and bodies of water.
